faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn suitable for Monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address ultrasonic tooling operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. ultrasonic tooling components receive DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Rotary horn / Seal horn ultrasonic tooling components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
